galleryChanges.change: Every urgent timer and the one aura share one warning loop and one phase: each urgent clock claims the view's one urgent loop, every urgent timer breathes while any claim runs (bec4454 stilled a second urgent timer), the first draws the one edge, and each new breathe is pinned to the document timeline's epoch. Fed by each clock's deadline adapter.

The urgent timer breathes on the edge's own rule — the same keyframes, 1.5 s period and easing (.2/.8/.2), a steady .5 when still or under reduced motion — in place of the shipped four-second stepped micro-pulse on the timer. The urgency state's urgent clock breathes with its edge; under reduced motion both hold .5.

TimerFrame carries the breathe on its `role="timer"` element (`clr-countdown-breathe`, `data-urgent`, the warning loop) in place of `clr-pulse-micro` on its wrapper; CountdownBar and RestTimerBar read the rest's deadline (`restDeadline`): the low colour, the fill's colour and "Final 10 seconds" from ten seconds, the breathe on the rest's timer (not the card) and the edge from five.

The compact SectionHeader reads "Section N / M · status" to assistive technology, visually hidden, and its visible "N / M" is decoration of the trigger (`aria-hidden`), so the trigger's one name is "All sections". Nothing drawn changes.

Each format clock's warning reads its adapter (EMOM minute, AMRAP window, race cap): held while paused, none once ended. The low colour at ten and the edge at five are as before; the breathe is the change above.

The circuit's round rest is one whole TimerFrame (the app's Card in the timer role) fed by `circuitRestDeadline`, in place of the package's TimerDisplay whose stepped micro-pulse ran through the last ten seconds. No state compared here draws a circuit; the circuit-round state shows it in the same commit.
A scheduled ladder's interval countdown is one whole TimerFrame fed by `scheduleIntervalDeadline`. No accepted state draws a schedule.
The movement countdown reads `movementCountdownDeadline`; its warning is unchanged but for the breathe above.
CountdownDisplay takes an optional deadline from its consumer; its drawing is unchanged (the route no longer draws it).
The adapters read only the fields of a view they need, so the route's flow feeds its attempt through them. Nothing drawn changes.
Previous, Next and a jump move focus to the opened section's first card with a temporary tabindex, falling back to its heading. Not a gallery state.

TASK-007's one-row header: the cluster never wraps to a second line; the title gives up width first and, at 23.75rem and below, takes the h3 size on the same line height. No accepted state draws the workout header.
